description: Show sandbox email message details and content from the sandbox test inbox. Optionally include spam report (SpamAssassin score) and HTML analysis (client compatibility) for email testing workflows.

include_html_analysis.description: When true, include HTML analysis (client compatibility, problematic elements). Critical for email client testing.

include_spam_report.description: When true, include spam report (SpamAssassin score and details). Critical for deliverability testing.

message_id.description: ID of the sandbox email message to retrieve

sandbox_id.description: Preferred. Mailtrap sandbox (test inbox) ID. Optional if MAILTRAP_SANDBOX_ID env var is set.

test_inbox_id.description: Legacy alias for sandbox_id. Used when sandbox_id is omitted.

name: show-sandbox-email-message
